s: The Taittiriya Upanishad belongs to which branch of the Vedas?
why: 'Branch of the Taittiriya Upanishad – Upanishad?' is garbled; the key (Krishna Yajurveda) is a branch, not an Upanishad
option 3 (2172 BCE) is the Mayiladumparai AMS date itself, so it was also correct
'Identify: Generally canonical; schools do not class their canon as the Pitakas alone' keys a vague heading ('Early literature'); no clear question possible

s: The Vaibhashika (Sarvastivada) school takes its name from being based on what?
why: 'Who founded Vaibhashika?' keyed 'Based on the Mahavibhasa', which is not a founder
option 3 'Guntur / Krishna valley' was also correct for Amaravati
Sankaram was in the old Visakhapatnam (Vizag) district, so 'Vizag' was arguably also right
notes place the Siddharthikas at Guntupalli too (see k408902d480b), so option 0 was also arguable
